title: Opening the Ellington show with Black and Tan Fantasy
summary: Green describes the show opening with the theme Black and Tan Fantasy, then hits like Sentimental Mood and Prelude to a Kiss before the first act.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: So, how was the show structured?
How did it open, what was in it, and then how did it close?
Well, it would open with the Duke Ellington Band theme song, which was at that time 'Black and Tan Fantasy.' Then they would play 'Sentimental Mood' (sic) 'Prelude to a

Kiss," My Old Flame" and hits of that day, you know. "Don't Mean a Thing if it Ain't Got that Swing." And then one of the acts would come on -- they would introduce the opening act. (End of tape 14) This is tape number 15 of the Chuck Green.
